jobs.title: Customer Success - Apptrove (Onboarding & Account Management)
jobs.description:
Apptrove is a Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) and mobile marketing platform that helps app businesses measure user acquisition, understand user journeys, attribute installs and in-app events, and optimize marketing performance. Through attribution, real-time reporting, deep linking, analytics, and fraud prevention capabilities, Apptrove enables businesses to make informed decisions, improve campaign ROI, and scale their app growth.

Apptrove is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a fair, inclusive, and respectful workplace. Employment decisions are made without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics.

Apptrove’s Social Media presence:

Linkedin - https://www.linkedin.com/company/apptrovemmp/posts/?feedView=all

Website- https://apptrove.com/
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/apptrove_hq/

Why this role exists

Apptrove is looking for a Customer Success Professional to own the customer journey from product demos and onboarding through implementation, go-live, and ongoing account growth. The role combines technical expertise and relationship management to drive successful integrations, product adoption, customer retention, and long-term growth through close collaboration with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support.

What you'll do

  • Lead product demos and discovery: Engage with prospective and newly acquired customers early in their journey, understand their business models and use cases, and tailor product demonstrations to their requirements.
  • Own onboarding end-to-end: Manage the customer journey from kickoff to go-live, maintaining clear visibility into timelines, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and progress across multiple accounts.
  • Drive technical implementation: Work hands-on with SDK/API integrations, app configuration, attribution links, postbacks, in-app event tracking, and tracking validation to ensure accurate data collection and attribution.
  • Manage implementation projects: Coordinate with client-side technical teams and internal stakeholders to ensure integrations are completed correctly, blockers are resolved, and onboarding progresses within agreed timelines.
  • Enable customers on the platform: Guide customers through Apptrove's dashboard, reporting capabilities, attribution setup, campaign tracking, deep linking, and relevant platform features to ensure they can use the product confidently.
  • Communicate proactively: Share relevant documentation, integration guides, checklists, action items, and next steps without waiting for customers to follow up.
  • Identify and mitigate risks: Anticipate implementation delays, technical gaps, tracking discrepancies, and stakeholder misalignment; take ownership of issues and drive them to resolution.
  • Manage ongoing customer relationships: Act as a trusted point of contact for existing customers, understand their evolving business needs, maintain regular engagement, and strengthen long-term partnerships.
  • Drive product adoption and customer outcomes: Review customer usage, attribution data, campaign performance, and business objectives to recommend relevant features, optimization opportunities, and improvements.
  • Own retention and account growth: Identify churn risks, support renewal discussions, and uncover opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion in collaboration with the relevant commercial teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve escalations, communicate customer feedback, and ensure timely closure of technical and business concerns.
  • Represent the voice of the customer: Share recurring challenges, product feedback, feature requests, and market insights with internal teams to improve the platform and customer experience.
  • Maintain account and project visibility: Keep onboarding trackers, customer records, account plans, project timelines, and relevant CRM information accurate and up to date.

jobs.requirementsSection:
• 3–6 years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Customer Success, Client Success, Onboarding, Implementation, or Account Management within a B2B SaaS or technology environment.
  • B.Tech/BE degree is mandatory.
  • Strong understanding of SDKs, APIs, postbacks, attribution links, tracking flows, and mobile app attribution ecosystems.
  • Practical experience with SDK/API integrations, app tracking configuration, in-app event setup, integration validation, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of mobile measurement platforms (MMPs), mobile user acquisition, performance marketing, and campaign attribution.
  • Experience leading product demos, onboarding calls, technical discussions, customer training, and stakeholder reviews.
  • Ability to understand customer business requirements and translate them into clear technical steps and actionable solutions.
  • Strong relationship-management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical teams and business decision-makers.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle management, product adoption, account health, retention, renewals, and expansion opportunities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret campaign performance and attribution data.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, stakeholder-management, and escalation-handling skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple customer accounts and implementation timelines independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong learning mindset, high ownership, and the ability to use AI tools responsibly to improve productivity and execution.

How you work & who you are

  • Proactive and Accountable: Take end-to-end ownership of customer onboarding and account management, anticipate customer needs, and ensure timely resolution of issues.
  • Hands-on and Solution-Oriented: Troubleshoot technical challenges, manage escalations, and drive issues to closure through effective problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Customer-Focused and Organized: Build strong customer relationships through clear communication, responsiveness, and contextual understanding while managing multiple accounts, priorities, and timelines.

Edges that help

  • Experience with MMPs, attribution platforms, AdTech/MarTech, or mobile marketing SaaS, with familiarity in deep linking, SKAN, fraud prevention, and mobile campaign optimization.
  • Experience managing international customers across time zones, using CRM and project management tools, and working in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

jobs.title: VP of Sales and Customer Success
jobs.description:
• Lead ClickView's growth across the US market, shaping the next phase of expansion for a leading educational technology platform
  • Build and lead a high-performing Sales and Customer Success team while remaining hands-on with key opportunities, coaching, and commercial execution
  • Permanent, full-time remote role based in the US, with occasional travel for in-person collaboration

Why Join Us?

Do you want to shape the future of education? At ClickView, we're on a mission to empower teachers and captivate students through the power of video. We’re committed to creating engaging learning experiences that inspire and improve outcomes for students of all ages and backgrounds around the world.

Join our passionate team dedicated to transforming education, and be part of something that’s more than just a job for us - it's a mission we truly believe in. We're committed to helping you develop your skills, explore new areas, and really shine in your career. At ClickView, your thoughts and creativity aren't just welcome, they're celebrated!

Ready to discover your potential with us?

The role:

The VP of Sales and Customer Success is responsible for leading the execution of ClickView's growth strategy in the United States, driving new business growth while building a disciplined, high-performing Sales and Customer Success function. This role is focused on establishing the operational foundations for scalable growth, including strong pipeline management, forecasting discipline, clear operating rhythms, and repeatable sales processes.

Working closely with the executive team, you'll translate strategic priorities into a clear commercial plan that delivers measurable results. As the senior sales leader on the ground, you'll combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution, coaching and developing the team, driving accountability, and personally leading key customer relationships and commercial opportunities where your involvement has the greatest impact.

Success in this role requires a confident and commercially minded leader who can build trust across the business, create a high-performance culture, and foster strong alignment between Sales, Customer Success, and the broader leadership team to achieve ambitious growth objectives.

What are the key accountabilities of this role?

  • Consistently driving sales success by partnering with the Executive team to execute a results-focused sales strategy targeting new business growth, working closely with the customer success team under a unified strategy
  • Lead, coach, and hold accountable a high-performing US sales team to identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities. Set clear expectations on activity, pipeline health, and conversion metrics, with a focus on priority districts and states
  • Establish strong operating rhythms across forecasting, pipeline reviews, and deal inspection - championing CRM discipline in Salesforce, and using data and historical trends to track revenue performance, monitor key metrics, and produce accurate, forward-looking forecasts and reporting for leadership
  • Report to the Executive team on business performance and work with other Sales leaders to standardise management practices across regions
  • Cultivate and leverage relationships with key customers, schools, and districts, acting as a brand advocate to expand ClickView's presence in priority markets
  • Collaborate with Marketing to ensure lead generation efforts translate into qualified pipeline, sharing market feedback and conversion data to help shape campaign strategy
  • Lead the Customer Success team to drive retention, expansion, and strong customer outcomes, ensuring a seamless end-to-end customer experience.

Requirements:

  • Significant experience leading sales teams within a high-growth technology or SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated track record of driving revenue growth and increasing market share through successful go-to-market strategy execution
  • Strong commercial acumen, with experience developing and executing sales strategies that deliver measurable business outcomes
  • Expertise in commercial negotiations, pricing strategy, and complex deal management
  • Experienced sales leader with a proven ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing teams through clear accountability, performance management, and operational excellence
  • Proven ability to establish repeatable pipeline generation, scalable sales processes, and disciplined operating rhythms that drive predictable revenue growth
  • Data-driven operator with strong Salesforce expertise, using pipeline metrics and CRM data to drive accurate forecasting, performance insights, and informed decision-making
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to quickly build credibility and influence across executive leadership and cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Customer Success

Nice to have

  • Experience in working within an EdTech or K-12 education provider is highly regarded
  • Experience carrying an individual sales quota alongside leading a sales team
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment without an established playbook
  • Experience contributing to go-to-market strategy development, in addition to successful execution

Benefits:

  • Paid leave - 20 days paid annual leave, paid sick leave and extra paid Wellbeing and Volunteering leave 🚴
  • 401k match and Platinum health insurance (80% coverage) - with vision and dental included 💰
  • Flexible working hours and arrangements - to accommodate for different working preferences and personal situations 🏠
  • Generous parental leave policy - offering 16 week’s full pay 🚼
  • 100 days working from anywhere - work remotely from a different location for up to 100 calendar days per year 🌎
  • Learning and Development budgets - professional opportunities made available to all our teams, so you can continue growing to be the best you 🥇
  • Wellbeing Policy - with access to EAP and wellbeing apps, we put your mental health and wellbeing at the forefront of what we do 💆‍♂️

ClickView makes video learning easy. We know that each student learns differently. We believe that video is the perfect way to engage with any student, despite differences in learning styles. At ClickView our goal is to give teachers the best opportunity to create a rich learning experience through video education for students.

From the videos we produce right here in Australia, the flipped classroom videos created by our community, to the free to air TV programs we curate, ClickView is revolutionising how video can be utilised to increase student engagement and boost student outcomes.

Our culture

Founded in 2003, we an Australian owned company and have over 80 employees worldwide with offices in Australia and the UK. We are a group of young, enthusiastic and passionate professionals who work hard and are empowered by the technology we use and the products we build. We are looking for more like-minded people who, like us, are motivated by their love of technology and whose unique personality can contribute to the team and the company in general.

jobs.title: Менеджер по сопровождению клиентов (CSM)
jobs.description:
В DMED мы создаём масштабные цифровые и государственные проекты. Главная цель Менеджера по сопровождению клиентов (CSM) — сделать процесс подключения клиники к нашей экосистеме максимально гладким, быстрым и безболезненным, а также выстроить эффективное взаимодействие с пользователями и обучить их работе с продуктами компании.

Обязанности:

Онбординг и запуск клиник:

  • Удалённое подключение частных медицинских учреждений к сервисам компании (MIS, LeadGen, E-Health).
  • Ведение клиента на всех этапах старта, снижая уровень стресса у главных врачей и администраторов при переходе на новую систему.

Обучение пользователей:

  • Проведение онлайн-обучения для сотрудников клиник.
  • Выдача понятных инструкций и проверка практического усвоения системы пользователями.

Сбор данных и настройка:

  • Запрос и проверка необходимой информации от клиник (включая фото врачей для профилей), помощь в создании учётных записей.
  • Помощь с вводом и настройкой ключей ЭЦП в проекте E-Health.

Работа с записями (проект LeadGen):

  • Подключение ботов в Telegram-группы клиник.
  • Отслеживание поступающих записей пациентов и контроль своевременной обработки заявок клиникой.

Базовый документооборот:

  • Формирование и отправка актов выполненных работ клиентам.
  • Контроль подписания документов и выдача доступов.

Замер качества:

  • Сбор обратной связи от клиентов и оценка уровня их удовлетворенности (NPS).

Внутренняя коммуникация:

  • Передача багов и пожеланий в IT-отдел.
  • Решение вопросов по тарифам с отделом продаж.
  • Взаимодействие с модераторами DMED и плавная передача готовых клиентов в Контакт-центр.

jobs.requirementsSection:
• Опыт работы от 1 года.
  • Высокая коммуникабельность, умение находить общий язык с любыми собеседниками (от главных врачей до администраторов на ресепшене).
  • Способность объяснять сложные технические вещи простым языком.
  • Умение спокойно и доброжелательно реагировать на негатив, технические заминки или сопротивление клиентов новым технологиям.
  • Умение оперативно понять, где клиент не разобрался с интерфейсом, а где требуется вмешательство разработчиков (отличие бага от фичи).
  • Высокая обучаемость и готовность глубоко изучить продукты компании (MIS, E-Health), принципы работы Telegram-ботов, ключей ЭЦП и интеграций.
  • Внимательность к деталям (проверка данных врачей, контроль актов, отслеживание статусов заявок в DMED).
  • Навыки тайм-менеджмента для параллельного ведения нескольких клиник на разных этапах запуска.
  • Внешние контакты: Владельцы клиник, главврачи, администраторы, в редких случаях — внешние органы (Минздрав).
  • Внутренние контакты: Отдел разработки, Отд
